mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 200k signals improving labor market conditions, which raises consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the following 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerating payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-quarter decline in the real Gross Domestic Product (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two-quarter GDP decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month period where the federal funds rate exceeds 5.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and lowering equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of restrictive policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 4% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction and related sector earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two-month HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two-month INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month increase in the Real Retail Sales Index (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and reduces recession risk, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of two-month RSAFS increases (t-test p > 0.05).
